cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein digestion on-bead was initiated upon addition of trypsin (ca. 1/1000 w/w protease to protein) and samples were incubated overnight at 37 °C and stage-tip purified prior to shotgun analysis on a QExactive mass spectrometer.

enrichment_method.evidence: Proteins (2 mg/mL, 0.4 %SDS in PBS) were subjected to CuAAC to a biotinylated site ID reagent (Az-RTB) followed by enrichment of target proteins on NeutrAvidin agarose resin.

labeling.evidence: inferred: No isobaric labels were used in this study.

ptm.evidence: Methionine oxidation as well as AMP-derived adducts (+624.1918 Da and +329.0525 Da) to Ser, Thr and Tyr were set as variable modifications.
